
? Name for the new machine

> Choose: laptop
\e[2mOK Name for the new machine laptop\e[0m

? Create separate access for this
  machine?

  Separate access lets you revoke
  this machine later without
  affecting other machines.

  1) Create a Cloudflare key
     (recommended) (default)
  2) Share existing access (revoking
     it affects all machines using
     it)

  [q] Cancel

> Choose [1]: create
\e[2mOK Create a Cloudflare key
   (recommended)\e[0m

? Press Enter when the pairing file
  or text has arrived on the other
  machine

> Choose:
\e[2mOK Press Enter when the pairing file
   or text has arrived on the other
   machine\e[0m

\e[?1049h\e[2J\e[H2. Enter the pairing code on the other machine

aardvark abandoned abbreviate abdomen abhorrence abiding

Keep this screen open while entering the code there.
The first three characters of each word work (yo- for yo-yo).
Deliver the code separately from the pairing file. Avoid recording or screen sharing.
Press Enter to hide.

\e[2J\e[H\e[?1049lPairing · Code available · Receiver completion unconfirmed
Finish setup on laptop. That machine confirms when its configuration is saved.

? Pairing

  1) Show code again

  [Enter] Close transfer
          instructions
  [q] Cancel pairing

> Choose: done
\e[2mOK Close transfer instructions\e[0m

Transfer instructions closed. Receiver completion is unconfirmed on this machine.
Delete any saved pairing files when no longer needed.
